name: Central Library Warm Space
description_original: The Central Library operates as a designated warm space during the colder months, offering a heated public area where visitors can sit, charge devices, and access free WiFi and hot drinks while staff are on hand to signpost to further support services.
description_plain:
The Central Library is a warm place to go in winter.
You can sit down and get warm.
You can charge your phone there.
There is free WiFi and free hot drinks.
Staff can tell you about other help you can get.

name: Leith Community Centre Warm Hub
description_original: Leith Community Centre opens a warm hub on weekdays, providing a welcoming heated lounge with seating, board games, free tea and coffee, and charging points for anyone who needs a warm place to spend time during the day.
description_plain:
Leith Community Centre is a warm place to spend the day.
It is open on weekdays.
There are chairs to sit on.
There are board games to play.
There is free tea and coffee.
You can charge your phone here.

name: Edinburgh Food Project - Leith
description_original: The Leith food bank is part of the Edinburgh Food Project network and provides emergency food parcels to local residents. Clients require a referral from a partner agency such as a GP, social worker, or Citizens Advice, and can collect a three-day supply of food.
description_plain:
The Leith food bank gives out emergency food.
You need a referral to get food.
A referral is a note from someone like your GP or a social worker.
The food lasts for three days.
Citizens Advice can also give you a referral.

name: Leith Community Fridge
description_original: The Leith Community Fridge rescues surplus food from local shops and offers it free to the community. No referral or proof of need is required; anyone may take food that would otherwise be wasted.
description_plain:
The Leith Community Fridge saves food from being thrown away.
Local shops give food they do not sell.
The food is free.
You do not need a referral.
Anyone can take food.

name: Edinburgh Central Library Free WiFi
description_original: Edinburgh Central Library provides complimentary public WiFi throughout the building to all visitors, with no time limit or library card required. Staff can assist users who need help connecting their devices.
description_plain:
Edinburgh Central Library has free WiFi.
It is for everyone who visits.
You do not need a library card.
There is no time limit.
Staff can help you connect.

name: Community Toilet - City Chambers
description_original: This location is part of Edinburgh's Community Toilet Scheme, meaning the public toilets are open to anyone during the venue's normal opening hours, at no charge, even for those not using the venue's services.
description_plain:
This is a public toilet you can use for free.
It is part of a city scheme called the Community Toilet Scheme.
You can use it during opening hours.
You do not have to be a customer.

name: Citizens Advice Edinburgh - Advice Shop
description_original: The Citizens Advice Edinburgh Advice Shop offers free, confidential and impartial advice on issues including benefits, debt, housing, employment, and consumer rights. Appointments and drop-in sessions are available, and interpreters can be arranged.
description_plain:
The Citizens Advice Advice Shop gives free advice.
The advice is private and honest.
They can help with benefits, money, housing, jobs, and rights.
You can book a time or walk in.
An interpreter can be arranged if you need one.

name: National Museum of Scotland
description_original: The National Museum of Scotland offers free admission to its permanent galleries, which cover natural history, world cultures, science and technology, and Scottish history. Temporary exhibitions may have an entry charge.
description_plain:
The National Museum of Scotland is free to enter.
You can see galleries about nature, the world, science, and Scottish history.
Some special shows cost money.

name: Refill Edinburgh - Portobello
description_original: This café participates in the Refill Edinburgh scheme, offering free tap water refills to anyone with a reusable bottle. No purchase is required to use the refill point.
description_plain:
This café gives free tap water refills.
Bring your own bottle.
You do not have to buy anything.

name: Edinburgh Health & Social Care Hub Drop-in
description_original: The Health and Social Care Hub offers a free, walk-in wellbeing drop-in where residents can get support with mental health, housing, money worries, and access to other local services, without needing an appointment or referral.
description_plain:
This is a free drop-in for wellbeing.
You can walk in without a booking.
Staff can help with mental health, housing, and money worries.
They can also tell you about other services.
